pages.title: Wandering Maids
pages.text: A Wandering Maid event may occasionally occur. A wandering maid approaches the player and asks to be taken in; the player may accept or refuse.

pages.title: Wandering & Trading
pages.text: The Wandering Maid Roster manages the related skin pool. Wandering Traders may also offer maid trading, allowing players to buy maids for sale or sell their own eligible maids.
